title: brief
description: A titled tree of sections, each with a one-line description, a markdown body, and — where what the section holds is a document of another kind — that document written in as `content: {kind, doc}`.

description.description: A one-line summary of the brief, read and kept on a dump. The viewer does not draw it: only a section's description is drawn.

sections.description: The titled tree; each entry is a section.

title.description: The section's heading; the tree shows it as a node.

description.description: One line about the section, drawn under its name in the content pane.

body.description: The section's prose, rendered as markdown.

children.description: Sections nested under this one, the same shape at any depth.

writtenDocument.description: A document written inside another. `kind` names the engine that renders `doc`; `doc` is the document exactly as a file of that kind would hold it — as that kind's YAML parses it, or its text for `md`. Checked by that kind's own engine. One document per section: a section that needs two has two children.

kind.description: Which engine renders the document — `playbook`, `kanban`, `md`, any kind the Studio knows.

doc.description: The document, as that kind's YAML parses it; a string for `md`.
